seed: hand-authored (IP network: an interfaces view against a topology view of one network; after an exchange on the NMOP list, November 2026)

false_cognates.why: interface vs interface-name: both carry 'interface', but one is the port itself and the other is the label the device gives it; a.if's true partner is b.tp, b.ifname's is a.ifname.

aggregate-interface (link aggregation) vs link: both suggest 'link', but one is a bundle of ports on one device and the other is a connection between two devices; a.agg's true partner is b.lag, b.link's is a.nbr.

if-index vs tp-id: both are identifiers of an interface local to one system, but one is a device-local index and the other is an identifier the topology system issues for itself; neither has a counterpart.
